_comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/verify_route_oracles.mjs. real = genuine street/data geometry (evidence in reason); known-bug = accepted pipeline artifact. Regenerate candidates with --write-whitelist, review in the triage gallery, prune stale entries as fixes land.
